rawText: honest, it probably took me 2 and 1/2 years to really understand this and about another year to actually perfect it. At this point in my journey, I still make mistakes where I still enter trades on anticipations, but I know exactly what I'm doing. I know I'm entering a trade on anticipation, and I'm totally okay with the outcome. The trade could go straight to my stop loss, and it won't matter to me. The problem with 99% of traders is that they enter these positions, they don't know the type of positions they're entering, they're not okay with the risk, and then when they lose a position, they go and point the finger at someone else. Not only do they have the wrong reasoning to enter the trade, not only do they not even know why they're entering the trade, but then they're putting the blame on anybody but their but themselves. sectionTitle: Time to learn, self-honesty, and blaming the market
